title: Round hay bale
description: A round hay bale lying on its side, axis along X (radius BALE.r 0.72, width BALE.w 1.15): a 14-sided golden straw barrel with two darker twine bands and a darker ring with a pale core on each round face. A single mesh node `bale`, instanced by the game.
checks: LEFT tile: a round face (near-circle) with a darker ring and a pale centre, sitting on the grid line
FRONT tile: a golden barrel, as wide as it is tall-ish, with two darker twine bands running round it
3/4 tile: reads as a round hay bale, not a log or a drum
